title: Portfolio, registry and correspondence operations in ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
You open the Portfolio page. A top bar shows the "ANDS Studio" brand with chips for "Help", "Dossier manager" and "Guided journey →". Under the heading "Portfolio" — subtitled "Every product dossier in your organisation — module progress, filing gate and fee status at a glance." — sit three summary cards: "Dossiers", "Ready to file", "Blocked", and a button "Export client status report (CSV)" that downloads a spreadsheet. Each dossier is a row: ID, title, a mini module tower, a gate chip reading "Ready to file" or a count like "3/5 modules", a fee chip ("Fee paid", "Fee waived", or "Fee due" with an amount), sometimes a litigation clock chip such as "NOA: 12d for brand to act", and links "Open →" and "Viewer". If empty: "No dossiers yet." with a link "Create one in the dossier manager →".

The registry and correspondence screens are not linked from this top bar — you reach them via "Registry" and "Correspondence" chips on the Dossier manager page (or the URLs /registry, /correspondence). On "Product registry", a "Register product +" button opens a form: "Product name", "Dossier ID" (placeholder "e123456"), "DIN (8 digits)", "Country", "Drug type", and the note "Leave the DIN blank until it is issued with the NOC." A wrong DIN shows "A DIN is exactly 8 digits (e.g. 02248808)". You submit with "Register product →". Each registration row shows the DIN (or "DIN pending"), a status chip, and transition buttons like "→ Marketed", or "No further transitions". A "Right-to-Sell deadlines" strip lists per-product due dates, and an "Annual notification checklist" of four tick-boxes carries the warning "Reminder only — this checklist is stored in your browser and is NOT filed with Health Canada or tracked by the registry service."

On "Correspondence & notices", a "Dossier" field (placeholder "e123456", pre-filled with your first dossier) plus an "Open" button reveals three stacked panels. "Notice inbox": pick a "Notice" type (hint: "Screening: SAL / SDN / SRL · Review decisions: NOC / NOD / NON"), a "Date on the notice", optional "HC reference (optional)" and "Subject (optional)", then press a button like "Ingest SAL"; a confirmation reports the logged record and any response window. If no lifecycle exists, you first set "Submission type" and "Received by HC on" and press "Start lifecycle". "Correspondence hub" lists every exchange with direction chips ("HC → sponsor" / "sponsor → HC"), a kind filter, and a "Log correspondence +" form ending in "Log record". "Form V / NOA register" offers "File Form V +" with "Patent / CSP number", "Allegation" and "Form V date"; per-patent buttons "Serve NOA" and "Record s.6 action" drive live day-count clocks like "45-day action window".
